en.text:
After being in Combat for 6 seconds:
Grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness and 35% Flinch Resistance for #e${10+#d} seconds.

Can activate while stowed. Dealing and receiving damage refreshes the buff duration.

For Pefect Float, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last #e${3+#f} seconds.

enhanced (
var d = 2
var f = 0.5
#e Buff duration is increased by 2 seconds. Allowed time between damage exchanges is increased by 0.5 seconds.
)
